findings.current: At this rate, two jokes would be enough to kill a man.
findings.defect: The English makes the jokes themselves sound lethal, while the source describes Team Leader Choi as looking ready to kill someone over the repeated jokes.
findings.rationale: The construction 사람 죽일 기세다 describes Choi’s threatening demeanor and makes him the implied agent of the killing; it is not a claim that the jokes themselves could kill.
findings.replacement: He looked ready to kill a man over two jokes.

findings.current: After ending his brief communication with Minister of Defense Wei Penghu, state chairman Xiao Yang sat alone in the vast conference room, lost in thought.
findings.defect: The word “alone” adds an unsupported physical detail and potentially excludes the secretary who speaks immediately afterward.
findings.rationale: The source says only that Xiao Yang sat in the vast conference room; it does not say he was alone, and the secretary addresses him in the following exchange.
findings.replacement: After ending his brief communication with Minister of Defense Wei Penghu, state chairman Xiao Yang sat in the vast conference room, lost in thought.

summary: Faithful overall, with two localized minor fidelity defects involving joke agency and an unsupported physical detail.
